beats.title: Her Mother's Name
beats.modern: last thing. Cosette, it's time you knew your mother's name. she was called Fantine. kneel when you say it. she suffered as much as you have been happy, that's just how it got divided up. remember Montfermeil? the forest, the bucket, the first time I ever touched your hand and it was freezing. love each other always, there's nothing else in the world. come closer, both of you. let me put my hands on your heads. gg.
beats.quote: She was called Fantine. Remember that name—Fantine.
beats.anchor: Cosette, the moment has come to tell thee the name of thy mother.
beats.endAnchor: He was dead. The night was starless and extremely dark.
